title: Keith J NDE & Pat's Second Person NDE 6142
content: On the eve of New Year's Eve, my 41-year-old husband developed powerful chest pains and I rushed him to the hospital. He had four major heart attacks and flat lined twice, once for 4-1/2 minutes. During this event, he immediately traveled out-of-body, toward the ceiling of the hospital room, carefully watching the nurses and doctor working on him. From this vantage point, he could see dark formless creatures erupting from the tile floor of the hospital room, which he instinctively knew to be sinister, and, although they tried to 'grab' at him as he rose, they were not successful yet they filled him with great fear. He then saw an otherworldly light, which he described to be the most 'glorious of all Florida sunsets' with perfect peaches, corals, roses and bright yellows. He rose to the sunset colors and was instructed to 'judge himself' during a life review. He later told me that the life review experience 'filled him with much shame' as everything was revealed to him, both small and large. As soon as the life review was complete, he met directly with God, a Divine Presence, and said, 'Where am I?' He was told, 'You are dead.' Characteristically, 'Keith', my husband (who made me memorize all of this; a chiropractor just recently killed him) argued with God saying, this: 'But, I have found love for the first time in my life and I do not want to be here.' He was told, 'You will go back through terrible pain. Now go back and save your people.' He returned to his body and promptly and punched the attending doctor in the nose, as Keith perceived, in that split second, that a car had hit him and that the doctor was the driver who had hit him. The doctor said, 'Whoa! Well, I guess he's back!' Eight months later, Keith picked me up at the bank where I worked, surprising me with a road trip to Atlantic City, NJ; a place I hadn't been to before. Atlantic City was a good drive of about 5-1/2 hours. The next day I set about to play quarter slots for the first time. Keith chose to stay at a machine a few aisles away. While playing, I noticed an older female security guard staring at me and she was making me uncomfortable. So, I cashed out and moved aisles. However she, quietly and furtively, moved along with me, setting up a point where she could continue to observe me. I can still see her in my mind's eye today. I was SO uncomfortable, I began to cash out again and move when Keith came over to check on me. He sat down right next to me and she, the security guard, came over and said, 'Are you Kim?' I replied, 'Yes.' She sighed and said, 'I have a story for you. Will you listen?' Keith and I became quiet and she sat down in the chair adjacent to me. 'Pat' explained that she had been in a medical coma two years prior because of a 'scarlet fever' type of illness. She had been discovered unconscious by a neighbor and brought to the hospital. While in this coma, 'in this Other Place', she was shown my face only, given my name as 'Kim' and told to 'find Kim.' And, so we had found each other but we didn't have the answers because we didn't have the questions. With the recent death of my beloved husband, Keith, I remain on an urgent quest to find out the meaning of Keith's NDE. We spent the last couple of decades trying to obey the Command given to him, as compulsively and obsessively as one can imagine. The 'Order' wasn't a suggestion. It was as if it occupied every cell of both of our beings. We also tried to understand the meaning of the security guard having been ordered to reach out to me (to find me) during her own OBE and NDE during her medical coma. I did communicate with the infinitely kind Dr. Moody, and he confirmed that, to his knowledge, there were only two incidents where an individual in the 'hereafter' was told to return and find someone within the Earthly Realm. One was an individual sent back to find him (Dr. Moody) and the other was my experience in Atlantic City. I am desperately trying to find out what is expected of me, and, of course, until I do find out, there is this sense of not being 'complete'.
